tools.name: feedback_submit
tools.title: Report a UserTold problem or suggestion
tools.description: Queues an authorized bug report or suggestion about UserTold to its team. The report cannot be recalled. Not for feedback about the user's product. Exclude credentials, personal data, and raw private content.

category.description: Nature of the feedback: bug for a failure, unexpected_behavior for a surprising result, confusing_behavior for unclear usage or output, or suggestion for an improvement.

summary.description: Concise description of the problem or suggestion without credentials, personal data, participant identity, or raw private content.

relatedTool.description: Optional MCP tool name related to the feedback, such as "evidence.list".

expectedBehavior.description: Optional concise description of what you expected UserTold to do.

actualBehavior.description: Optional concise description of what UserTold did instead, including a safe error message when useful.

additionalContext.description: Optional safe reproduction steps or context. Do not include credentials, personal data, participant identity, or raw private content.

annotations.title: Report a UserTold problem or suggestion

tools.name: setup_recommend
tools.title: Plan user interviews and usability research
tools.description: Use when the user wants customer discovery, interviews, usability tests, concept tests, or research into onboarding, churn, pricing, or feature feedback. Pass their goal in their own words. Returns guidance grounded in UserTold documentation and saves the request and response for service improvement without changing projects or studies. For account references, existing results, or an exact operation, call the relevant tool directly.

request.description: The user’s research or feedback goal in their own words; exclude personal data and secrets because requests are saved for service improvement.

annotations.title: Plan user interviews and usability research

tools.name: projects_list
tools.title: Find accessible research projects

offset.description: Number of accessible records to skip; defaults to 0.

annotations.title: Find accessible research projects

tools.name: organizations_list
tools.title: Find accessible research organizations
tools.description: Lists accessible organizations and their organizationRef values for projects.create. No reference is needed. Returns 25 records per page; when truncated is true, increase offset by count.

offset.description: Number of accessible records to skip; defaults to 0.

annotations.title: Find accessible research organizations

tools.name: projects_create
tools.title: Create a product research project
tools.description: Creates a private project and draft starter interview study in an organization from organizations.list. Returns projectRef for later calls. Does not configure billing, members, or GitHub/Linear connections.

handle.description: Optional URL-friendly handle; a unique handle is generated from the name when omitted

annotations.title: Create a product research project

tools.name: projects_get_widget_setup

projectRef.description: Canonical project reference in org/project format, as returned by projects.list.

annotations.title: Get website interview installation and readiness

tools.name: projects_verify_widget_installation
tools.title: Check website interview installation
tools.description: Checks the UserTold widget loader, project key, and browser security policies on a public HTTPS page. Replaces the saved verification URL and time after a passing check and preserves previous success on warnings or failures. Does not execute the app or verify microphone and screen permissions in a browser.

launcher.description: Compact button that opens the Study Invitation.

label.description: Short participant-facing button label. Example: "Share feedback".

icon.description: Launcher glyph: mic for a voice interview, feedback for general feedback, diagram for evidence, bug for defect reporting. research is a magnifying glass and reads as a search box next to a label.

style.description: Launcher treatment. calm is flat with nothing in motion; lattice carries a field of nodes with one travelling signal; beam runs a hairline around the edge; ticket adds a perforated stub printing panel.duration_minutes. Defaults to lattice.

shape.description: Launcher corner radius: capsule, rounded, or square. Defaults to capsule.

panel.description: Expanded invitation panel. Required when presentation_mode is contextual or direct_link; optional for passive.

eyebrow.description: Optional short label above the headline.

cta.description: Call-to-action label that starts the interview. Example: "Start interview".

reward.description: Optional single reward promise shown to participants.

kind.description: Reward kind: gift, product, community benefit, or access.

eligibility.description: Optional eligibility condition for receiving the reward.

delivery.description: Optional explanation of how or when the reward is delivered.

image.description: Optional HTTPS image shown in the expanded panel.

asset_id.description: Stable identifier for the referenced image asset.

url.description: Absolute HTTPS URL for the image.

alt.description: Accessible alternative text; use an empty string only for a decorative image.

presentation_mode.description: How participants encounter the Invitation: passive launcher, contextual panel, or shareable direct link. contextual and direct_link require panel.

brand_color.description: Six-digit hexadecimal brand colors used by the Invitation.

foreground_color.description: Optional launcher and Invitation foreground color, for example "#ffffff". Omit it to choose black or white automatically for each brand color.

placement.description: Screen corner used for the launcher on desktop and mobile.

invitation.description: Participant-facing launcher configuration, or null to inherit the built-in compact launcher. Minimal passive example: {"launcher":{"label":"Share feedback","icon":"research"},"presentation_mode":"passive","brand_color":{"light":"#2563eb"},"placement":{"desktop":"bottom-right","mobile":"bottom-right"}}.

enabled.description: Whether this Study participates in automatic placement. false disables it without changing lifecycle status.

rules.description: Optional ordered page rules. Exclusions win before the most specific matching inclusion.

effect.description: Whether a matching pathname is eligible or blocked.

match.description: exact matches one pathname; subtree also matches descendants.

pathname.description: Absolute pathname beginning with /. Do not include origin, query, or fragment. Example: "/docs".

priority.description: Placement priority; higher values win after route and language specificity. Use 0 unless explicit ordering is needed.

order.description: Stable project order; lower values win final ties. Use 0 for a single Study.

visibility.description: Visibility v1 object, or null to inherit enabled placement on all pages and supported languages. enabled:false opts out. Ranking applies exclusions, route specificity, language specificity, higher priority, then lower project order. Example: {"version":1,"enabled":true,"rules":[{"effect":"include","match":"subtree","pathname":"/docs"}],"languages":["en"],"priority":0,"order":0}.

allowedOrigins.description: Customer origins where the install-once Project widget runs. Use origins only, without a path, query, or fragment. A direct-link Invitation uses the first origin to build its shareable campaign URL; [] clears the list and revokes URL publication. Example: ["https://app.example.com"].

realtime_site_search.description: Request the experimental realtime_site_search capability. true is an opt-in request, still subject to service availability; omit unless the Study explicitly needs it.

realtime_knowledge_query.description: Request the experimental realtime_knowledge_query capability. true is an opt-in request, still subject to service availability; omit unless the Study explicitly needs it.

realtime_visual_snapshots.description: Request the experimental realtime_visual_snapshots capability. true is an opt-in request, still subject to service availability; omit unless the Study explicitly needs it.

realtime_visual_guidance.description: Request the experimental realtime_visual_guidance capability. true is an opt-in request, still subject to service availability; omit unless the Study explicitly needs it.

realtime_same_origin_navigation.description: Request the experimental realtime_same_origin_navigation capability. true is an opt-in request, still subject to service availability; omit unless the Study explicitly needs it.

experimental_capabilities.description: Optional experimental runtime capability overrides. Omit for the stable default behavior.

defaults.description: Optional defaults inherited by segments unless overridden.

voice.description: Default GPT-Live-1 voice identifier for Talk segments.

system_prompt.description: Default interviewer instructions shared by talk segments.

speak_submode.description: Default speech delivery profile for speak segments.

language.description: Default BCP 47 interview language, for example "en" or "de".

script.description: Complete StudyScriptV2 interview flow. Serialized JSON must be 250000 characters or fewer. Minimal example: {"version":2,"segments":[{"id":"opening","title":"Understand the problem","mode":"talk","instruction":"Ask what the participant was trying to accomplish."}],"goals":[]}.

segments.title: Understand the problem
segments.instruction: Ask what the participant was trying to accomplish.

id.description: Stable goal identifier referenced by talk.goals. Example: "understand_blocker".

description.description: What the interviewer should learn, written as a concrete research objective.

items.description: One reusable research goal with a stable id and an interviewer-facing description.

goals.description: Replacement study-level goal metadata; use the same goal shape as script.goals.

intakeRef.description: Intake handle returned by studies.get to attach, or empty string to detach.

launcher.description: Compact button that opens the Study Invitation.

label.description: Short participant-facing button label. Example: "Share feedback".

icon.description: Launcher glyph: mic for a voice interview, feedback for general feedback, diagram for evidence, bug for defect reporting. research is a magnifying glass and reads as a search box next to a label.

style.description: Launcher treatment. calm is flat with nothing in motion; lattice carries a field of nodes with one travelling signal; beam runs a hairline around the edge; ticket adds a perforated stub printing panel.duration_minutes. Defaults to lattice.

shape.description: Launcher corner radius: capsule, rounded, or square. Defaults to capsule.

panel.description: Expanded invitation panel. Required when presentation_mode is contextual or direct_link; optional for passive.

eyebrow.description: Optional short label above the headline.

cta.description: Call-to-action label that starts the interview. Example: "Start interview".

reward.description: Optional single reward promise shown to participants.

kind.description: Reward kind: gift, product, community benefit, or access.

eligibility.description: Optional eligibility condition for receiving the reward.

delivery.description: Optional explanation of how or when the reward is delivered.

image.description: Optional HTTPS image shown in the expanded panel.

asset_id.description: Stable identifier for the referenced image asset.

url.description: Absolute HTTPS URL for the image.

alt.description: Accessible alternative text; use an empty string only for a decorative image.

presentation_mode.description: How participants encounter the Invitation: passive launcher, contextual panel, or shareable direct link. contextual and direct_link require panel.

brand_color.description: Six-digit hexadecimal brand colors used by the Invitation.

foreground_color.description: Optional launcher and Invitation foreground color, for example "#ffffff". Omit it to choose black or white automatically for each brand color.

placement.description: Screen corner used for the launcher on desktop and mobile.

invitation.description: Participant-facing launcher configuration, or null to inherit the built-in compact launcher. Minimal passive example: {"launcher":{"label":"Share feedback","icon":"research"},"presentation_mode":"passive","brand_color":{"light":"#2563eb"},"placement":{"desktop":"bottom-right","mobile":"bottom-right"}}.

enabled.description: Whether this Study participates in automatic placement. false disables it without changing lifecycle status.

rules.description: Optional ordered page rules. Exclusions win before the most specific matching inclusion.

effect.description: Whether a matching pathname is eligible or blocked.

match.description: exact matches one pathname; subtree also matches descendants.

pathname.description: Absolute pathname beginning with /. Do not include origin, query, or fragment. Example: "/docs".

priority.description: Placement priority; higher values win after route and language specificity. Use 0 unless explicit ordering is needed.

order.description: Stable project order; lower values win final ties. Use 0 for a single Study.

visibility.description: Visibility v1 object, or null to inherit enabled placement on all pages and supported languages. enabled:false opts out. Ranking applies exclusions, route specificity, language specificity, higher priority, then lower project order. Example: {"version":1,"enabled":true,"rules":[{"effect":"include","match":"subtree","pathname":"/docs"}],"languages":["en"],"priority":0,"order":0}.

allowedOrigins.description: Customer origins where the install-once Project widget runs. Use origins only, without a path, query, or fragment. A direct-link Invitation uses the first origin to build its shareable campaign URL; [] clears the list and revokes URL publication. Example: ["https://app.example.com"].

annotations.title: Edit, start, or pause an interview study

tools.name: evidence_list
tools.title: Find user problems, quotes, and workarounds
tools.description: Searches interview Evidence for user problems, needs, workarounds, or successful experiences. Returns paginated quotes, observations, and source references for review or grouping into Findings. Defaults to product_under_test; target_surface="all" includes other areas.

projectRef.description: Canonical project reference in org/project format, as returned by projects.list.

signal_type.description: Filter by evidence type. Canonical generated values: struggling_moment, desired_outcome, workaround, hiring_criteria, firing_moment, emotional_response, no_issue_found, smooth_completion, critical_error, recovery_success, decision_point. Historical or reviewer-authored Evidence may use another value; copy signal_type from an evidence.list result when filtering those records. Example: signal_type="struggling_moment".

target_surface.description: Filter by area (product_under_test, usertold_widget_interview, interviewer_conductor_behavior, ambiguous_needs_review, or all)

interviewRef.description: Filter by an interviewRef returned by interviews.list

studyRef.description: Filter by a studyRef returned by studies.list.

findingRef.description: Filter by a findingRef returned by findings.list, or "none" for unlinked Evidence

search.description: Search quote, observed behavior, generated summary, and interpretation text

limit.description: Maximum results (default and max 5); use offset for the next page

annotations.title: Find user problems, quotes, and workarounds

tools.name: evidence_get
tools.title: Inspect a user quote or observed problem
tools.description: Returns one Evidence observation with its quote, observed behavior, interpretation, source interview and timestamp, page context, review state, and linked Findings. interviews.get_context provides the surrounding moment.

projectRef.description: Canonical project reference in org/project format, as returned by projects.list.

signalId.description: Evidence reference returned by evidence.list or studies.get_results.

annotations.title: Inspect a user quote or observed problem

tools.name: evidence_update
tools.title: Annotate, dismiss, or restore interview evidence
tools.description: Replaces or clears an Evidence annotation, dismisses it with a reason, or restores it with dismissed=false. Returns the updated Evidence. Changes private UserTold review state and recalculates linked Findings when dismissal changes.

projectRef.description: Canonical project reference in org/project format, as returned by projects.list.

signalId.description: Evidence reference returned by evidence.list or studies.get_results.

annotation.description: Replacement annotation text, or null to clear it explicitly

dismissed.description: Set true to dismiss this Evidence or false to restore it

reason.description: Required reason when dismissed=true; omitted when restoring

annotations.title: Annotate, dismiss, or restore interview evidence

tools.name: findings_list
tools.title: Find product improvements supported by research
tools.description: Lists product problems and improvement opportunities collected from interviews. Returns paginated Findings with priority and supporting Interview/Evidence counts. Closed Findings are hidden by default; findings.get_evidence returns their sources.

projectRef.description: Canonical project reference in org/project format, as returned by projects.list.

status.description: Filter by status: backlog, ready, in_progress, done, wont_fix

target_surface.description: Filter by area (product_under_test, usertold_widget_interview, interviewer_conductor_behavior, ambiguous_needs_review, or all)

search.description: Case-insensitive search across Finding title and description

limit.description: Maximum results (default and max 10); use offset for the next page

enriched.description: Include signal_types[] and studyRefs[] per Finding

annotations.title: Find product improvements supported by research

tools.name: findings_get_evidence
tools.title: Check the research behind a product finding
tools.description: Returns a Finding's linked Evidence, Interview timestamps, uncertainty, related Findings, possible recurrence, and decision summary. Check truncation flags before editing, planning follow-up research, defining acceptance criteria, or sending it externally.

projectRef.description: Canonical project reference in org/project format, as returned by projects.list.

findingRef.description: Finding reference returned by findings.list or findings.create_from_evidence

evidenceLimit.description: Maximum linked Evidence items (default and max 3)

annotations.title: Check the research behind a product finding

tools.name: findings_create_from_evidence
tools.title: Group interview evidence into a product finding
tools.description: Creates a private backlog Finding from reviewed Evidence and calculates priority. Moves selected Evidence out of other active Findings while preserving link history. Mark it ready only after source review. Does not create a GitHub or Linear issue.

projectRef.description: Canonical project reference in org/project format, as returned by projects.list.

signalIds.description: Evidence references returned by evidence.list or studies.get_results to link to this Finding.

annotations.title: Group interview evidence into a product finding

tools.name: findings_update
tools.title: Edit or mark a product finding reviewed
tools.description: Overwrites supplied Finding fields and can attach or detach Evidence. Attaching Evidence moves it out of other active Findings while preserving link history. Set status="ready" only after checking sources, grouping, product relevance, and uncertainty. Changes UserTold only; findings.send is the separate GitHub or Linear handoff.

projectRef.description: Canonical project reference in org/project format, as returned by projects.list.

findingRef.description: Finding reference returned by findings.list or findings.create_from_evidence.

status.description: Finding status. Setting ready explicitly records Review; it never writes to a provider.

effort_estimate.description: Effort estimate: xs = extra small, s = small, m = medium, l = large, xl = extra large. Example: use "m" for medium effort.

addEvidenceRefs.description: Evidence references returned by evidence.list or studies.get_results to attach to this Finding.

removeEvidenceRefs.description: Evidence references returned by evidence.list or studies.get_results to detach from this Finding.

annotations.title: Edit or mark a product finding reviewed

tools.name: interviews_list
tools.title: Find recorded user interviews
tools.description: Lists recorded participant Interviews for review, download, or processing checks. A projectRef is sufficient. Returns paginated summaries and interviewRef values for context, artifact, and processing tools. Supports Study and Interview status filters and omits participant identity fields.

projectRef.description: Canonical project reference in org/project format, as returned by projects.list.

studyRef.description: Filter by a studyRef returned by studies.list.

annotations.title: Find recorded user interviews

tools.name: interviews_get_context
tools.title: Inspect what happened around an interview moment
tools.description: Returns a limited transcript window and sanitized navigation/click events around timestamp_ms. Check truncation flags; interviews.get_artifacts provides the complete transcript and recordings.

projectRef.description: Canonical project reference in org/project format, as returned by projects.list.

timestamp_ms.description: Center of the time window in milliseconds

window_seconds.description: Half-width of the window in seconds (default 60, max 600)

annotations.title: Inspect what happened around an interview moment

tools.name: interviews_get_artifacts
tools.title: Download interview transcripts and recordings
tools.description: Returns availability and resource links for a complete Interview transcript, audio, screen recording, and activity events, not file contents. Download transcript_text once for the exact transcript. Links expire after five minutes. Original captured content remains unchanged.

projectRef.description: Canonical project reference in org/project format, as returned by projects.list.

interviewRef.description: Interview reference returned by interviews.list or studies.get_results.

annotations.title: Download interview transcripts and recordings

tools.name: interviews_processing_status
tools.title: Check interview analysis progress
tools.description: Returns saved Interview processing and Evidence extraction status with result counts. Does not start processing; interviews.retry_processing starts a new attempt only for an eligible failure or stall.

projectRef.description: Canonical project reference in org/project format, as returned by projects.list.

annotations.title: Check interview analysis progress

tools.name: interviews_retry_processing
tools.title: Retry failed interview analysis
tools.description: Starts a new processing attempt after interviews.processing_status shows a durable failure or no progress for 24 hours. Replaces generated Evidence and preserves manual Evidence. Completion can email the owner according to their notification preferences. If the outcome is uncertain, check status and do not retry automatically.

projectRef.description: Canonical project reference in org/project format, as returned by projects.list.

annotations.title: Retry failed interview analysis

tools.name: findings_send
tools.title: Send a researched product issue to GitHub or Linear
tools.description: Sends an authorized reviewed Finding with linked Evidence to GitHub or Linear. Creates and returns an external issue, or returns the previously recorded issue. Omit provider for the configured destination; pass "github" or "linear" only as an explicit override. The issue cannot be recalled.

projectRef.description: Canonical project reference in org/project format, as returned by projects.list.

findingRef.description: Reviewed Finding reference returned by findings.list or findings.create_from_evidence

provider.description: Optional delivery override. Omit it to use the server-selected destination.

annotations.title: Send a researched product issue to GitHub or Linear

tools.name: recordings_create_invitation
tools.title: Invite a participant to record a website
tools.description: Creates a single-participant Chrome recording invitation in an existing project. Assigns the website and tasks, returns launchUrl and plain installation instructions. The participant needs no account; finishing automatically uploads to this project. Supply externalRef to make retries idempotent. Does not send invitations or make recordings public.

projectRef.description: Canonical project reference in org/project format, as returned by projects.list.

studyRef.description: Filter by Study handle returned by studies.list.

annotations.title: Invite a participant to record a website

tools.name: recordings_create_website_invitation
tools.title: Prepare a website feedback invitation
tools.description: Prepares feedback for a website in an authorized organization. Creates or reuses a private project for the complete website URL and returns a single-participant Chrome recording invitation. Default first-impression tasks are supplied when instructions are omitted. externalRef makes repeated assignment creation idempotent. The participant needs no UserTold account. Does not send invitations.

annotations.title: Prepare a website feedback invitation

tools.name: recordings_get_results
tools.title: Get invited recording results
tools.description: Returns an assigned recording status, interview reference, private organizer URL, and any enabled viewing link. Poll this for a known invitationRef; completed means source upload is durable, while transcription and analysis may still be processing. Does not expose other participant recordings.

projectRef.description: Canonical project reference in org/project format, as returned by projects.list.

annotations.title: Get invited recording results

tools.name: recordings_update_invitation
tools.title: Change recording invitation access
tools.description: Explicitly changes recording invitation access. revoke stops invitation use and future uploads and revokes its viewing link. share creates a 30-day viewing link to a completed recording that anyone holding the link can open or embed. unshare revokes future viewing-link access; already issued media URLs expire within five minutes. Sharing rotates the prior link. Does not delete an interview.

projectRef.description: Canonical project reference in org/project format, as returned by projects.list.

action.description: revoke closes participant access; share enables or rotates a 30-day viewing link; unshare disables it.

annotations.title: Change recording invitation access
